parameters.content:
## Quad campus notifications
Run **Preview both alerts** to see the morning digest and a sample reminder.
The schedule uses Vancouver time. The delivery ledger prevents repeat alerts on later runs.
Set opted-in recipients in **Quad settings**. Connect your account and enable **Send email via Gmail** before turning on the email channel.
